name: Scavenger receptor-mediated ligand clearance
rationale: All four members are scavenging by scavenger receptor classes A, B, F and H, whereas every confusable is a monocyte/myeloid identity or chemotaxis set with no scavenger receptor pathway.

qualifier: sterols plus ubiquinone and vitamin K quinones
name: Isoprenoid synthesis of cholesterol, ubiquinol and vitamin K quinones
rationale: Members span the mevalonate/isoprenoid route (IPP, FPP, GGPP) into lanosterol and cholesterol branches and into isoprenoid quinones (ubiquinol, menaquinone/vitamin K), the quinone arm separating it from dolichol, bile-acid and peroxisomal-lipid confusables.

name: Lung branching, saccular development and pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: All members concern lung growth and morphogenesis (branching, lobes, vasculature, perinatal ductus closure), and saccule development with type I/II pneumocyte differentiation distinguishes it from surfactant, lung mesenchyme and trachea confusables.

qualifier: with molybdenum cofactor and PLP synthesis
name: Selenium and sulfide metabolism with cofactor biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover ingested selenium compound metabolism and methylation, sulfide oxidation and cysteine catabolism, plus prosthetic-group synthesis (molybdenum cofactor, pyridoxal phosphate), which the transsulfuration and glutathione confusables lack.

name: Neuropeptide and opioid signalling in sleep-wake regulation
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/orexin and opioid GPCR signalling, dense-core vesicle release and nerve-impulse modulation with sleep-wake states, distinguishing it from confusables built on mating, aggression and stress/CRH responses.

name: Fc-epsilon receptor mast cell activation and hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are FcERI signalling, mast cell differentiation, degranulation and histamine release, and hypersensitivity reactions, setting it apart from Th2/eosinophil cytokine and Fc-gamma phagocytosis confusables.

name: Olfactory and sour taste chemosensation
rationale: Members are odorant/pheromone detection by olfactory receptors and sour taste perception, distinguishing it from confusables covering sweet, bitter, umami and salty taste or nasal development.

name: Plasma membrane iron import and systemic iron homeostasis
rationale: All members concern cellular iron uptake, its regulation and organismal iron balance, unlike confusables on transferrin cycling, heme synthesis, neutrophil granules or erythrocyte gas transport.

name: Potassium channel-driven cardiac action potential repolarization
rationale: Members are cardiac action potential phases 1-4, atrial/ventricular repolarization and Kir, voltage-gated and TWIK potassium channels, while confusables emphasize depolarization, His-Purkinje conduction or non-cardiac K+ channels.

qualifier: pro-apoptotic and G1 arrest target genes
name: p53-driven transcription of apoptosis and G1 arrest genes
rationale: Members describe p53 regulation and its transcription of caspase, death-receptor, cytochrome c release and p21/G1 arrest genes, distinguishing it from confusables on negative regulation, p14ARF/p16 senescence evasion and DNA repair/G2 checkpoints.

qualifier: netrin, ephrin and SLIT-ROBO cues acting via Rho GTPases
name: Netrin, ephrin and SLIT-ROBO guidance via Rho GTPases
rationale: Members are netrin/DCC, EPH-ephrin and SLIT-ROBO signalling with RAC1/CDC42/RHOA regulation and growth cone collapse, distinguishing it from L1, semaphorin-plexin and commissural midline confusables.

qualifier: preintegration complex import, integration and APOBEC3G restriction
name: HIV-1 preintegration complex import, integration and restriction
rationale: Members cover Vpr-mediated PIC nuclear import, proviral integration, 2-LTR and autointegration circles, and APOBEC3G restriction, whereas confusables cover entry, reverse transcription, HCMV or retroelement silencing.

qualifier: KIR and MHC class Ib control, target protection
name: KIR and MHC class Ib control of NK cytotoxicity
rationale: Members concern NK degranulation, granzyme killing, protection from NK cytotoxicity, MHC class Ib presentation and the KIR cluster, the KIR/tolerance arm separating it from NK activation and T cell cytotoxicity confusables.

name: Protein lysine and proline hydroxylation and trimethylation
rationale: Members are peptidyl hydroxylation (lysine, proline) and lysine trimethylation/protein methylation, distinguishing it from RNA modification, diphthamide/hypusine and arginine or mono/dimethylation confusables.

qualifier: influenza vRNP nuclear phase and RSV
name: Influenza and RSV replication cycle and host evasion
rationale: Members span influenza vRNP import, synthesis, export and translation with host PKR and mRNA-processing inhibition, plus RSV transcription, replication and assembly, unlike coronavirus and HIV confusables.

name: Fibroblast stroma adhesion and KRAS/FOSL-driven proliferation
rationale: Members combine stromal ECM/complement and cell adhesion modules with fibroblast proliferation, KRAS-up and FOSL1/2 targets, the proliferative arm distinguishing it from YAP/TAZ, CXCL12 stromal and ECM-only confusables.

name: Mitochondrial calcium uniporter-mediated calcium uptake
rationale: All members concern calcium import into mitochondria including uniporter subunit SMDT1 processing, whereas confusables are mitochondrial protein import, processing and degradation.

qualifier: IL-10/IL-12 families, IL-15/21, interferon-lambda and NK/NKT regulation
name: IL-10/IL-12-family, IL-15 and interferon-lambda signalling regulating NK/NKT cells
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20, IL-12/23/27/35, IL-15/21 and type III interferon signalling with NK/NKT proliferation and differentiation, distinguishing it from IL-17/IL-33, TNF/NF-kB and Th2/IL-6/IL-2 cytokine confusables.

name: Dendrite arborization and dendritic spine structural plasticity
rationale: Members cover dendritic spine formation and maintenance, postsynaptic actin and receptor trafficking, dendrite branching, reelin and NMDAR-RAC1 signalling, distinguishing it from synapse-adhesion assembly, LTP/memory and Rho GTPase polarity confusables.

qualifier: action potential, conduction and sarcoplasmic calcium handling
name: Cardiac action potential, conduction and calcium-handling contraction coupling
rationale: Members span cardiac action potential phases and channels, SA/AV/His-Purkinje conduction, gap junctions, and SR/store-operated calcium release and reuptake controlling contraction, unlike confusables on non-cardiac K+ channels, sarcomere/myogenesis, hypertrophy or cAMP signalling.

name: Stress granule dynamics and regulation of proteasomal protein degradation
rationale: Members regulate ubiquitin-proteasome protein turnover and destabilization alongside stress granule assembly/disassembly and PKR signalling, the stress-granule arm distinguishing it from ubiquitination, ribosome quality control and PML confusables.

qualifier: cadherin adherens/tight/desmosomal junctions, apical-basal polarity and EMT
name: Cadherin-based cell-cell junctions, epithelial polarity and EMT
rationale: Members cover adherens, tight and desmosomal junction assembly, cadherin adhesion, apical-basal polarity, barrier permeability and EMT, unlike confusables on cornification, basement membrane/integrins, leading-edge actin or shear-stress mechanosensing.

name: MTF1-metallothionein zinc response
rationale: All three members describe zinc sensing and MTF1-driven metallothionein metal binding, separate from heavy-metal (cadmium, lead, mercury) and ROS-detoxification confusables.

name: Dietary lipid digestion and chylomicron/VLDL assembly
rationale: Members cover intestinal lipid digestion and absorption, acylglycerol transport and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly, distinguishing it from bile acid, HDL/LDL remodelling and lipoprotein clearance confusables.

qualifier: IRF3 activation, necroptosis and herpes encephalitis deficiencies
name: Endosomal TLR3-TRIF signalling, necroptosis and herpes encephalitis defects
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3 trafficking, TRIF-driven TBK1/IRF3 activation and necroptotic death, and TLR3-pathway deficiencies in herpes simplex encephalitis, unlike TLR7/8/9 MyD88-IRAK and IKK/TAK1 confusables.
